lines: "If somebody built this, why build the boring parts? Twelve hours of me standing here. Queues. Sleep."
"Now that's the only decent point you've ever made."
"I admit it's wasteful, which is an argument against your theory, not for it. Anyone with the power to skip the dull half would skip it. This place doesn't skip anything. It grinds."
"Then it's a cruel one, and I'd rather blame people. People are available."
